Manifest.Name: 直接替换 / Quick Replace
Manifest.Author: w7lau
Manifest.Description: 把新滤芯拖到水壶上，或把新电池拖到电器上，直接换下旧的。旧件放回原来的物品栏，放不下就不换。 电池拖到充电器上，可换出其中剩余电量最多的一块；只换电量比拖入的更高的。 Drag a new filter or battery onto a device to replace the old one. The old item returns to the source inventory; nothing is swapped if it cannot fit. Drag a battery onto a charger to take the one with the most remaining energy, only if it has more charge than yours.
